title: A Trial of Varenicline for E-cigarette Cessation
official: Investigating Efficacious E-Cigarette Interventions and Cessation Effects on Cancer-Related Biomarkers: A Randomized Trial of Varenicline in Adults
summary: This is randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial in treatment-seeking adults who report regular e-cigarette use to test the hypothesis that varenicline is efficacious for quitting e-cigarettes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* report daily use of an e-cigarette containing nicotine
* live in Connecticut or South Carolina

Exclusion Criteria:

* regular use of other tobacco products besides e-cigarettes
* medical contraindications for varenicline use
* current treatment for tobacco cessation
* lack proficiency in English

sites.f: Yale Cancer Center/Smilow Cancer Hospital at Yale-New Haven
